message: No detected input validation: The code passes arguments directly to downstream functions without any visible schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice, and no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against expected sets, or noise-detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the visible code paths.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code reads CSV/FASTA files and passes them directly to encoding and modeling functions without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models (pickle files) via arguments like '--model' and '--params' without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any stress-testing routines are referenced or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate training (--ls) and test (--ts) sets are used, there is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of evaluation data, and no evidence of multiple independently-computed metrics used to cross-check results against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming sequences or arguments before passing them to the model; only basic argument parsing and type coercion (e.g., abs/int on thread count) are present.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model predictions are visible in the inference data-flow path shown.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline handles protein sequence/fitness data and is not an LLM text-in/text-out system, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not implemented.
